decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed extensions would be acceptable due to their position, design and appearance. The development would not harm the appearance of the area, neighbours' living conditions or highway safety and complies with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development) and  H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the The London Borough of Hounslow Adopted Unitary Development Plan 2003.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

(Reason.  In order to safeguard the visual amenity of the area and building in particular and to satisfy the requirements of policies ENV B1.1New Development and H6.4 Extensions and alterations)

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no windows/dormer windows [other than those expressly authorised by this permission] shall be constructed.

(Reason.  In order not to prejudice the amenities of the adjoining properties and in order that the Local Planning Authority is able to exercise control over future development of the site in accordance with policy H6.4 Extensions and Alterations of the Hounslow UDP and policy H6.2 Environmental Improvements in residential areas)

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

(Reason.  To protect the amenity and privacy of nearby residents  in accordance with policy ENV.B.1.1 New development)
description: Erection of a second single storey rear extension and erection of a side / rear conservatory to house
